question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

I have to save this coupon **__in case I come back to the store tomorrow__**.

options.text: in case I came back to the store tomorrow
if in case I come back to the store tomorrow
in case I will come back to the store tomorrow

solution:
The correct answer is **"No substitution​."**
